analysis.bootstrap: resample runs and whole paired worlds; common indexes across all services
analysis.identical_snapshots: evaluate every registered job; differences between identical skills are sampling noise, not evolution
analysis.limitations: one training repeat; world bootstrap is conditional on this training realization; exploratory evidence only, no stable training/generalization claim
analysis.repeats: 1 independent world/interaction runs; no provider determinism claim
analysis.success: exploratory comparisons only; one training repeat cannot support preregistered robust gain

budget_matching: same episode opportunities, models and per-run hard caps; A unused Customer Reflection budget is not reassigned
connector_override: user explicitly authorized local RSI identity on 2026-10-15

estimates.currency_reason: gateway provides no verified monetary tariff; no dollar figure invented

failure_policy: no retry; failed or incomplete smoke/training blocks heldout; evaluation failures retained; budget/provider stops are BLOCKED
primary: balanced task-level heldout correctness: 0.5 legal completion + 0.5 explicit correct refusal
provider_preflight: one 32-output-token connectivity call; separate preflight record, not training or heldout
